task_description: Guard the teacher-agreement ceiling: how often the two cheap Gemini teachers land on the same decision as the Pro reference teacher on the synthetic pilot states. A student trained on their labels cannot be expected to beat this.
models: gemini-2.5-flash-lite + gemini-3.1-flash-lite, both scored per run against gemini-3.1-pro-preview

metric.unit: share (0-100) of question decisions where the cheap teachers' mean distribution has the same argmax (choice) or the same side of 0.5 (yes/no) as the Pro reference

baselines.name: first pilot, 28 synthetic states
baselines.notes: 2026-09-20 run, $0.39; per-question and per-model breakdown in the run JSON. n=28 so the 95% interval is roughly +-8 points.

contamination.notes: Synthetic states written by gemma3:4b; labels by Gemini. No real message data was sent to any hosted API. Nothing here is tuned.

prediction.statement: The two cheap teachers agree with the Pro reference on at least 85% of question decisions. If they do not, the labelling recipe is too noisy to train on and needs a stronger or a different teacher.
